name: Arima Naoya
source:
A person who has steadily built up his career at a Zaizen company, he is a bartender for the luxury hotel "Chateau Epinu".
His head is very sharp.
He's easygoing, but he's kind to everyone.
It seems that there is a connection behind Kurosaki.

[From [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/nemurihime/chara/naoya_arima.html]official website[/url]]
